newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mobile Telecom raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mobile Telecom raised.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Kurt Abkemeier raised his rating for Mobile Telecommunication Technologies Corp Thursday to buy from market performer.

-- He wrote in a report that the upgrade was based on "an improvement in operating results, improvement in financing status, recent significant insider buying, improved clarity of performance and demonstration that Mtel's new management understands the business."
-- Abkemeier raised his 1997 year-end target price to $15 a share.
-- Shares in the Jackson, Miss., paging services company opened up 1-3/16 at 9-13/16.
